verdict.rationale: Querying raw events with SQL is a fair question for an analytics and experimentation platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-platform SQL or SQL-equivalent query interface. Metrics Explorer is described only as a chart-based analysis UI, and Warehouse Native means running Statsig features on the user's own warehouse, which is not an SQL query capability inside Statsig.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query my raw events with SQL (or an SQL-equivalent query language) inside the platform
